name: Avatar/Single
description:
**Overview:** Displays a single user or entity profile picture.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use in headers, profiles, or lists.
- ❌ DO NOT use for system brand logos.

**Props / Variants:** Status (Online/Offline), Shape (Circle/Square), Size, Theme, Background.

**Original Notes:** Visual representations of users, bots, or groups using images or initials.
